meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. This is a research coding of the laws in effect on January 1, 2021, made by the Legal Services Corporation and Temple University from statutes, regulations and court rules. Laws change and local rules can differ; confirm the current rule in the official code before relying on it. Prepared for research and marketing planning.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.

records.unit: jurisdictions with a coded residential eviction law
records.text: United States, laws in effect January 1, 2021: the 50 states, DC and five territories (56 in all) have a coded residential eviction law; 5 require just cause, 42 give a tenant a right to cure nonpayment, 16 regulate late fees, 4 require no notice before filing for nonpayment, 17 set a 3-day notice and 9 a notice of 14 days or more, 5 have a mediation rule and 0 give tenants a statutory right to free counsel.
